content_sections.heading: About ICMR-NIRWoH
content_sections.text: ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women's Health (ICMR-NIRWoH) is an Indian Council of Medical Research institute on Jehangir Merwanji Street, Parel, Mumbai 400012. ICMR-NIRWoH has issued this notice for the TERIIP project study, which ICMR funds. The Data Entry Operator will be posted at ICMR-Regional Medical Research Centre, Sri Vijaya Puram, in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Intermediate or 12th Pass in Science from recognized Board and/or Two years' Experience in EDP Work. Graduate with computer knowledge. The age limit for the Data Entry Operator post is 28 years. The notice does not mention a date on which age is counted. The notice says that only candidates who meet the eligible qualifications should apply. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post pays a consolidated salary of Rs.20,960/-. The vacancy will be filled on a purely temporary basis for the TERIIP project study. The selected candidate will be deployed through an outsourcing agency. The appointment is for 1 year, with a further extension of 10 months based on performance.

content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIRWoH Data Entry Operator Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these job responsibilities for the Data Entry Operator: Willingness to travel to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Data Entry and Data management. Clinical sample shipment and report delivery to participants. Other duties assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR-NIRWoH Data Entry Operator
content_sections.text: Open the online application link given in the notice: https://application.nirrch.res.in/login.php. Select the post 'Data Entry Operator-[SVP]' to apply for this post. Submit the online application on or before 06 November 2026. If you have a problem submitting the application this way, email [email protected] and [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: ICMR-NIRWoH will screen all applications. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for a physical interaction / online interview. Shortlisted candidates will be told the interview details later.
